# D — Outside readers and significance (evidence reader, side-session 2026-10-03)

Status: COMPLETE (2026-10-03). Facts from the program's own record only; every row cites file and line and quotes the deciding words. The private e-mail of row 2 of Table 2 is paraphrased, not quoted.

## Plan (at most 20 lines)

1. Read `rh-program/CIRCULATION-PREP.md`, `rh-program/results/arxiv/` (README, POSTING, DE-INTERNALIZATION, referee reports), root `README.md`, `CITATION.cff`, `public/`, `results/x67-landing-s41/`, `results/external/prove2me/NOTE.md`.
2. Grep LOG.md and STATUS.md (windowed) for: circulat, arXiv, endors, Zenodo, DOI, x67, e-mail, wrote to, replied, referee, expert, mathematician, courtesy note, alkl23, Lamzouri, sponsor's decision, prove2me.
3. Table 1 "What went out": separate PUBLISHED/SENT (a line says so, by whom) from PREPARED (draft, checklist, Zenodo draft).
4. Table 2 "Human readers": every human other than the sponsor named as reader, recipient or answerer; courtesy notes marked SENT / NOT SENT / no line found.
5. Table 3 "Agent referees": blind-referee agents per outgoing text, verdicts verbatim; human or agent stated with the quote.
6. Table 4 "Ranking criteria as written": grep digests and queue texts for survivor filter, merit, ranking, funding.
7. Table 5 "Correct but known": grep pre-empted, printed core, in print since, folklore, well known, standard, trivial, of no interest.
8. Closing paragraph: does any step ask "would a specialist care, what would they ask instead?" Quote or "not found" with patterns.
9. No e-mail addresses copied; names and roles only. Append a dated block to SHARED.md after each batch.

SENT to named outsiders: 3 — the ÁLKL note to its three authors (e-mail), the same PDF to ChatGPT (by the sponsor), the landing-page source to validator.w3.org (by an agent). Went out by accident, then purged: 1 row (16 PDFs, 2 PDFs, 1,533 third-party paths and a private e-mail; three purges). PREPARED, not sent: 4 — arXiv packages (endorsement never obtained), `m0`/`m1` papers, social-media post drafts, a Prove2Me mission. ## Does any step ask "would a specialist in this object care, and what would they ask instead?"

One step comes close, once, for outgoing papers only. Answering the sponsor's question *"it's pointless if the paper carries nothing novel and doesn't contribute to the field, right?"* (`CIRCULATION-PREP.md` l. 249–250), STEP 5 (2026-08-27) sorted the four August papers by "Would anyone otherwise have tried this?" (l. 258), named the audience of the cubic-augmentation paper — "people working on pair-correlation LP/SDP methods for the distinct-zeros and simple-zeros problems — but it is a real audience with a real question" (`results/arxiv/README.md` l. 26–27) — and said of the Tate-products note that for a journal it is "an assembly of known results applied to a new object, which a referee may reasonably call a remark rather than a paper" (`CIRCULATION-PREP.md` l. 322–324). The same test is echoed once in `STATUS.md` l. 355. **The second half — what a specialist would ask instead — was not found.** The test was not found applied to the Haglund paper (the record calls it "a publishable-grade result (a counterexample to a 2009 conjecture that implies RH, certified twice)", `STATUS.md` l. 157, `LOG.md` l. 2123) or to any internal unit, digest or queue. Searched: `LOG.md`, `STATUS.md`, `KICKSTART.md`, `CIRCULATION-PREP.md`, `BRIEF-WARNINGS.md`, `results/arxiv/**`, every digest, program digest, direction file and charter, then all 814 `.md` files under `rh-program/` (except `fetched*/`, `sources-extracted/`, `.lake`, and the two external study folders), with the patterns `specialists?|would care|care about|what would (they|a specialist|an expert|experts) ask|audience|would anyone otherwise|would ask|ask instead|the real question|question the literature|literature actually (asks|poses)|of interest to|so what|publishable|worth (publishing|posting)|outside reader|never heard of`. Other hits are about readability or error-catching, not interest: "would a reader who has never heard of this" (`results/arxiv/DE-INTERNALIZATION.md` l. 9), "Read `main.pdf` first as an outside reader would" (`results/arxiv/haglund-counterexample/REFEREE-BRIEF.md` l. 3), "Any competent reader in the CCM/transcendence audience catches it" (`results/c3-r/referee-seed-no-go.md` l. 91).
